note: Canonical note for a thing that matters to the story (item, artifact, contract).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Fixed classifier — always `object`. Set by the template; do not change it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Text. The object's canonical name. Should match the note title.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: List of text. Other names for the object.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: A single `[[Character]]` link to who owns or controls the object. A typed relation — always a wikilink. Leave empty if unowned.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Select — e.g. `contract | artifact | relic | item`. The category of object.

fields.name: first_appearance
fields.description: Text — a `[[scene note]]` link. The scene where the object first appears.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Text. The series this canon belongs to.

fields.name: image
fields.description: Media. Optional `[[wikilink]]` to the thumbnail image with its full vault path (e.g. `[[Images/Moonharbor Lighthouse.svg]]`), which Meta Bind's image view needs — a link, so it survives a rename. Rendered only when set, like a character's `portrait`; a bare vault path or URL still displays.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: List. Always includes `canon/object` — how views and Bases select object notes.
